title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 08:00 UTC on 28 September 2026.

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.00 (0Z) at 08:00 UTC on 28 September. The 08:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 08:59; hour-start 0.00/0Z, hour-end 1.00/1Z). evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of the most complete recent hour (08:00 UTC on 28 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The public feed is a rolling ~6-hour window, not a full-day archive.
